ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Saved orientation session or personal dance consultation note created by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this session.

topic.description: Topic of the orientation query (e.g., Edades, Clases, Presupuesto).

summary.description: Summary of the orientation or calculation saved by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated.

TrialBooking.title: TrialBooking
TrialBooking.description: Free trial dance class booking synchronized with Google Calendar and La Ponte Dance.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who booked the trial class.

studentName.description: Full name of the student attending the trial class.

ageGroup.description: Selected age group (Niños, Jóvenes, Adultos, Parejas).

preferredDate.description: Date of the trial class in YYYY-MM-DD format.

preferredTime.description: Time slot of the trial class in HH:MM format.

calendarEventId.description: Google Calendar event ID returned on synchronization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was last updated.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores user-owned chatbot orientation and dance calculation sessions.

/trialBookings/{bookingId}.description: Stores user-owned free trial class bookings synchronized with Google Calendar.
